items.raw_excerpt: The Crasto Sports Complex in Baguim do Monte,in the Gondomar municipality, will be hosting the fourth edition of BrickMarket on 11 October.
items.summary_en: A Lego market will open on 11 October in Baguim do Monte, a small town near Gondomar in Portugal. This is the fourth time the event runs at the Crasto Sports Complex. Families and Lego fans can come to see, buy and trade small brick models.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 곤도마르 지역의 작은 마을 바긴 도 몬테에서 레고 마켓이 10월 11일 다시 열린다. 크라스토 스포츠 센터에서 사 번째로 열리는 이번 행사는 레고 모형을 보 사고 바꾸는 가족과 팬들이 모인다.
items.title_en: Lego Market Comes Back to Gondomar

items.raw_excerpt: La mexicana de 58 años tuvo que ser atendida por personal médico.
items.summary_en: Mexican singer Alejandra Guzman had to stop her show after her hip slipped out of place. The 58-year-old artist was treated by medical staff. She was not able to go on with the performance.
items.summary_ko: 멕시코 가수 알레한드라 구스만(58)이 공연 중 고관절이 빠져 공연을 취소했다. 의료진의 진료를 받았다. 그녀는 무대를 계속할 수 없었다.
items.title_en: Singer Alejandra Guzman Cancels Show After Her Hip Slips Out
items.title_ko: 알레한드라 구스만 가수, 고관절이 빠져 공연 취소
items.title_original: Cantante Alejandra Guzmán tuvo que suspender show porque se le zafó la cadera

items.raw_excerpt: The desire for more room, greater tranquillity, and a way of life based on the idea of 'slow living' has meant that traditional Alentejo country mansions (montes) have become attractive investments—whether one wants to use them as permanent residences, as weekend getaways, or as part of rural tourism initiatives.
items.summary_en: Old country houses in Portugal's Alentejo region are becoming popular to buy. People like them for the space, the quiet, and a slower way of life. Some buy them as full homes, some as weekend houses, and some to run rural tourism.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 알렌테주 지역의 전통적인 농가가 인기가 높아지고 있다. 넓은 공간과 조용한 환경, 느긋한 생활을 누릴 수 있다는 점이 매력이다. 전문_FULL-time 주택으로 사는 사람, 주말 집으로 사는 사람, 농촌 관광 시설로 운영하는 사람이 함께 생기고 있다.
items.title_en: More People Want to Live in Alentejo
items.title_ko: 알렌테주 지역에 사는 사람이 늘고 있다
items.title_original: The Alentejo is becoming more attractive as a place to live

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan's Yu Kai-wen (余凱文) and Huang Shih-yuan (黃詩媛) won gold in the soft tennis mixed doubles final at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Monday, defeating a Japanese pair in a nail-biting match to secure Taiwan's first gold medal at this year's Games.
items.summary_en: Yu Kai-wen and Huang Shih-yuan won gold for Taiwan in the soft tennis mixed doubles final at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. They beat a Japanese pair in a close match. It is Taiwan's first gold medal at this year's Games.
items.summary_ko: 대만 선수 위커우언과 황스위위안이 2026년 아이치나고야 아시아선 소프트테니스 혼합복식 결승에서 금메달을 차지했습니다. 이들은 일본 선수 쌍을 접선 끝에 이겨 역대 첫 금메달을 거머들였습니다.
items.title_en: Taiwan wins its first Asian Games gold in soft tennis mixed doubles
items.title_ko: 대만, 소프트테니스 혼합복식에서 아시아선 첫 금메달
items.title_original: Taiwan wins first Asian Games gold in soft tennis mixed doubles

items.raw_excerpt: Ein Film von Rose Glass | ab 18. Juli 2024 im Gartenbaukino
items.summary_en: Gartenbaukino cinema in Vienna shows a film by Rose Glass. The film starts on July 18, 2024. The cinema is a small local place in the city.
items.summary_ko: 빈나의 가르텐바우키노 극장에서 로즈 글레스가 만든 영화가 상영된다. 상영 시작일은 2024년 7월 18일이다. 도심에 자리한 작은 지역 극장이다.

items.raw_excerpt: Housing minister Elanor Boekholt-O’Sullivan has drawn up a list of 50 locations where the Dutch government wants to speed up housebuilding to meet the target of 100,000 new homes a year. The plan includes 26 sites near railway stations that are already well served by transport links and utilities, making them relatively easy to develop. The first five locations have already been identified in Maastricht, Haarlem, Leeuwarden, Deventer and Weert, with another five due to be announced later this ye
items.summary_en: The Dutch government has made a list of 50 places where it wants to build homes faster. The plan aims for 100,000 new homes every year. Twenty-six of the spots are close to train stations with good transport links. The first five areas are in Maastricht, Haarlem, Leeuwarden, Deventer and Weert.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 정부가 연평균 10만 채를 목표로 주택을 더 빠르게 지을 50개 지역을 골랐다. 이 가운데 26곳은 철도역 근처로 교통과 기반 시설이 잘 되어 있어 개발이 쉽다. 첫 5개 지역은 마스트리흐트, 하를렘, 레이우아르던, 데벤터, 베르트가 각각이다.
items.title_en: Dutch government picks 50 places to build homes faster
items.title_ko: 네덜란드 정부, 주택 빠른 건설 50개 지역 선정
items.title_original: Government identifies 50 sites for accelerated housing programme
